subject: Adding limited textual annotations to a plot

messages.author: ad0352231b6aa86d
messages.subject: Adding limited textual annotations to a plot
parts:
Hi,

I would like to add limited textual annotations to a plot -- to have a plot with many points and then add a handful of textual annotations on top of it. For example, in base graphics:

d <- data.frame(x=1:10,y=1:10)
plot(y ~ x, d)
text(6,4,"Label")

For ggplot2 I have tried

qplot(x,y,data=d) + layer(geom="text",geom_params=list(x=6,y=4,label="Label",hjust=0))

but that doesn't cut it. I would appreciate any suggestions!

Best & many thanks,

Roger
